Header: Plutella xylostella In Sinhala: Diyamanthi pitahedathi salabhaya , In Tamil: Diamond muthuku anthu

Prevention: Destruction of crop residues of all crucifers
Use of organic manure to improve soil
Use recommended fertilizers. (Avoid excessive amount of nitrogen )
Conservation of natural vegetation in the system to conserve natural enemies.
Monitoring: DBM Monitoring to detect feeding damage, green larvae, pupae in cocoons on leaves
Use of light trap to detect the presence of the pest
Apply insecticides, at the first sign of damage
Direct Control: Hand picking of larva and pupa at very early stages
Use botanicals such as neem seed water extract
Restrictions: Apply insecticides, at the first sign of damage and repeat at 2 week intervals, if necessary.
Maximum number of treatments 4; Dangerous for environment; Very toxic to aquatic organisms; WHO Class
U (Unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use)
